activities.title: Ghorawadi (Shelarwadi) Caves
activities.description: Explore the ancient Buddhist‑Hindu rock‑cut caves about 25 km northwest of Pune. The site is free to enter (small donation of ~₹50 per person). Travel by hired car/rideshare (≈₹200 round‑trip per person).

activities.title: Lunch at Shabree (Shivaji Nagar)
activities.description: Enjoy a popular Maharashtrian thali with roti, bhaji, dal, and dessert. Estimated cost ₹400 per person.

activities.title: Indori Fort (Induri Fort) Visit
activities.description: Drive to Indori Fort (≈35 km north of Pune). Walk the historic fort, enjoy panoramic views of the Indrayani River valley. Entry fee ~₹50 per person; transport cost included in the round‑trip car fare.

activities.title: Coffee & Light Snacks at Café Goodluck
activities.description: Relax with a cup of coffee and a snack before heading back. Approx. ₹100 per person.
